baselineBoundary.purposeOfM2: Prove lifecycle, reward, unlock and persistence correctness on the existing campaign before changing its content surface.
baselineBoundary.note: Passing M2 makes the current campaign a trustworthy runtime baseline. It does not make repetitive baseline quest design permanent product doctrine.

access.dominantMechanic: possess representative keys or representative access capability
access.repetitionFinding: Most map quests vary the map and key pool while keeping the same possess-representative-keys decision. The text repeatedly describes access coverage and the success copy repeatedly confirms coverage. This is substantially better than the 27-quest legacy key ladder, but it is still a map-by-map capability checklist rather than ten distinct operations.
access.postM2Direction: Retain only access milestones that enable a different player decision. Prefer real route-use/VisitPlace operations when exact SPT semantics permit, and remove map-only copies that exist solely because a map has keys.

arsenal.repetitionFinding: Seven weapon families each repeat Qualification -> Fieldwork -> Munitions using the same core elimination mechanic with a larger counter. The munitions stage adds a controlled ammo payoff, but the player's action still repeats. This is a deterministic, economy-safe replacement for hundreds of legacy weapon/ammo quests, not a final authored campaign standard.
playerFacingExamplesOfDebt: Show me you can use <family> effectively under real conditions.
Keep using <family> in the field and show consistent results.
Prove the capability once more and I will open a controlled ammunition allotment.
arsenal.postM2Direction: Collapse repeated family stages. A weapon family should earn its place through a distinct tactical role or a single meaningful qualification; ammo access should be a payoff, not a reason to repeat the same kill objective a third time.

doNotDo: Do not rewrite the runtime 31-quest baseline before M1 lifecycle correctness and M2 physical acceptance are complete.
Do not preserve 31 quests after M2 merely because 31 was the frozen test shape.
Do not transfer removed quest rewards into surviving quests as a quota.
Do not replace removed Access or Arsenal copies with filler to maintain quest count.
Do not hide identical mechanics behind longer EN/RU text.

interactionWithCurrentM3.borrowedAccess: Designed as a route-use operation and intentionally demonstrates the quality direction for future Access cleanup.
interactionWithCurrentM3.observationWindow: Designed as a contextual application of existing Precision Fieldwork rather than another generic precision kill-counter stage.
interactionWithCurrentM3.heavyAssault: Does not require an assault-rifle family gate because protective fieldcraft is the actual decision.
interactionWithCurrentM3.principle: Future authored operations should consume proven capabilities from the baseline, then progressively make redundant baseline checklist quests retireable.
